blocking_finding.detail: The helper constructs jackin_live from origin/<branch> before merge, then after merge writes jackin_restored computed from that remote-only text. If local HEAD has non-fast-forward/branch-ahead changes to the same file that merge auto-combines, or a permitted Jackin conflict is resolved with additional content, the later write discards the merged non-remote content. The per-key computation is correct for origin ad20 but is not applied to the post-merge worktree blob. This violates preservation of concurrent/unpushed content. After merge, re-read the merged worktree file (or verify the merged file is byte-identical to the pinned remote file outside the 22 targeted values), validate exact 22 preimages there, then archive and transform those merged bytes. Any unexpected local-only deltas should fail closed for review.

positive_findings: Helper validates the exact audit packet SHA and all 22 live value preimages before the merge.
Pure in-memory transformation of exact ad20 blob yields the expected 22 pre-089 values; all 42 remaining rows, header/comments, and line bytes are identical; no row inventory change.
Theme73 remains correctly called out as separate and unadmitted.
review: read-only static helper review; no helper execution, git mutation, lock, source edits, tests or push
safe_to_execute: No. Pure transform is correct, but merge/worktree source mismatch is a data-preservation blocker unless coordinator proves HEAD is exactly synchronized and conflict cannot introduce preserved changes, or patches helper to transform merged bytes.
